QuestInfo.name: A Price to Pay
QuestInfo.0: #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, seems to be hiding something.
QuestInfo.1: #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, wouldn't say a word, insisting that person wouldn't want to be known — but worn down by my persistent pleading, he reluctantly set one condition. That condition was for me to bring him #t4000036# for his research. It seems I should be able to get #b#t4000036#s#k by defeating #b#o40#s#k, found far off from #m10004000#, or #b#o45#s#k deep within the Ant Tunnel.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I handed over the #t4000036#s to #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#. Now it's time to hear his story about the warrior who saved #p207#.

0.0: You truly are a persistent one. Very well, you've worn me down. But I won't simply tell you for nothing. As it happens, I'm short on materials for some research I'm working on, so if you bring those to me, I might just tell you what you want to know.

yes.0: What I need are #b#t4000036#s#k. You should be able to get them by defeating #b#o40#s#k, found far off from #m10004000#, or #b#o45#s#k deep within the Ant Tunnel. Go on, then.

no.0: Heh... so that's as far as your goodwill went, is it?

1.0: Ah, you're back. Let's see... #b50 #t4000036#s#k, without a doubt. Well, I suppose I can't make any more excuses now, can I. Hah...

item.0: If you bring me #b50 #t4000036#s#k for my research, I might just be willing to tell you about that person.
